title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse on 1970-01-10
venue: Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.0.1 -> Cool Edit Pro v2.0 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel-> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard capture of an urgent early‑1970s show featuring a scorching Mason’s Children/Black Peter and Pigpen‑driven rockers.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as great with no noted technical flaws, suggesting a clean soundboard source.  The performance radiates urgency, highlighted by powerful versions of Mason’s Children, Black Peter, China Cat Sunflower (early in the era), and hot Pigpen numbers like Hard to Handle and Good Lovin'.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (4‑5 stars) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and overall audio quality indicate a strong show with good recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention the audio as "great" with no specific complaints; no drop‑outs or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as urgent and upbeat, with many rock‑driven numbers and strong Pigpen performances that keep the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen (keyboard/vocals) is highlighted as "very hot" on Hard to Handle, Good Lovin' and Love Light.
